shortDescription: Colombian inflation rose more than expected to a two-year high, according to Bloomberg, increasing pressure on the central bank to resume interest-rate increases.The bank paused rate hikes at its most recent meeting.

title: Colombia Inflation Surges to Two-Year High, Pressuring Rate Outlook
